0 FILE operative_shield.mpd
0 Name: The Living Shield (Rotational Assembly)
0 Author: Grace Assembler
0 !LDRAW_ORG Model
0 !LICENCE Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0
0 BFC CERTIFY CCW
0 //
0 LEGOS OPERATIVE NOTES:
0 System: Technic Turntable Core
0 Layer 1 (Center): Static Divine Will (Sun/Eagle)
 
0 Layer 3 (Rim): The Oceanus Boundary
0 //
0 STEP 01: AXIS MUNDI (The Mechanism)
0 // We start with a 4x4 baseplate and a Turntable Base
1 7   0 0 0    1 0 0   0 1 0   0 0 1   3031.dat
1 7   0 -8 0   1 0 0   0 1 0   0 0 1   3680.dat
0 STEP
0 //
0 STEP 02: THE HUMAN PLANE (Rotating Platform)
0 // Turntable Top - This piece rotates relative to the base
1 7   0 -8 0   1 0 0   0 1 0   0 0 1   3679.dat
0 //
0 // We attach a 2x4 plate to the turntable to hold our "Cities"
1 7   0 -16 0  1 0 0   0 1 0   0 0 1   3020.dat
0 STEP
0 //
0 STEP 03: THE TWIN CITIES (Mounted on the Human Plane)
0 //
0 // CITY OF PEACE (Left Side)
0 // Symbolized by the Green/Gold Rohan Shield (Agriculture/Harvest)
0 // Mounted on a "Headlight Brick" (4070) to face outward
1 2   -20 -26 0    0 0 1   0 1 0   -1 0 0   4070.dat
1 14  -24 -26 0    0 0 1   0 1 0   -1 0 0   75902p01.dat
0 //
0 // CITY OF WAR (Right Side)
0 // Symbolized by the Lion Shield (Predation/Conflict)
0 // Mounted on a "Headlight Brick" facing outward opposite Peace
1 8   20 -26 0     0 0 -1  0 1 0   1 0 0    4070.dat
1 14  24 -26 0     0 0 -1  0 1 0   1 0 0    3846p4o.dat
0 STEP
0 //
0 STEP 04: THE COSMIC CENTER (Static & Elevated)
0 // The Cosmos must sit ABOVE the rotating cities, fixed to the center stud.
0 // We use a 1x1 Round Brick (open stud) to pass through, or simply stack on center.
0 //
0 // The Sun/Eagle Shield (Zeus)
1 14  0 -40 0      1 0 0   0 1 0   0 0 1    75902p03.dat
0 STEP
0 //
0 STEP 05: OCEANUS (The Boundary)
0 // These are placed on the ground layer (Baseplate), not the turntable.
0 // They enclose the mechanism.
0 //
0 // North (Blue Tile)
1 1   0 0 -30      1 0 0   0 1 0   0 0 1    3068b.dat
0 // South (Blue Tile)
1 1   0 0 30       1 0 0   0 1 0   0 0 1    3068b.dat
0 // East (Blue Tile)
1 1   30 0 0       0 0 1   0 1 0   -1 0 0   3068b.dat
0 // West (Blue Tile)
1 1   -30 0 0      0 0 1   0 1 0   -1 0 0   3068b.dat
0 STEP
0 //
0 NOTE: OPERATIVE FUNCTION
0 // The center (Eagle) remains still.
0 // The middle layer (Lion/Rohan) can be spun by hand.
0 // The outer blue tiles remain still, containing the chaos.
0 NOFILE
